summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package is advertised as a stylelint configuration but its `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and invokes it against a 727KB bundled file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and is heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array with numeric index table, single-letter mangled identifiers, `WV8StW(...).push(.shift())` decoder), and contains references to `.aws`, `/proc`, and low-level filesystem primitives (`fd`, `r+`, `w+`, `rm`) that have no connection to stylelint rule configuration. The loader `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) wrapping the `child_process`/`https`/`fs` calls that perform the runtime download and payload execution. The Bun runtime is used specifically so the payload executes outside Node's inspection surface. This behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
